tasks.label: Test selector (IRM + error body)
tasks.command: $body = '{"date":"2026-01-30","max_candidates":5,"min_minutes_to_kickoff":60}'; try { Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'http://localhost:8000/v1/selector/run' -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 } catch { Write-Host $_.Exception.Message; if ($_.ErrorDetails -and $_.ErrorDetails.Message) { Write-Host $_.ErrorDetails.Message } }
